title: Choosing the Robot for the Job: A Task Written as Numbers, Each Family Checked Against It, and the Fastest One That Passes Everything

artifact.note: the capstone of the arm course: a task written as numbers (the area of the work, the payload, a tilt or none, the accuracy, the cycle time wanted, the length of the moves); the five kinds of robot of the arm course with typical figures (payload, speed, acceleration, repeatability, tilt, the height they work at, how far from the work they are mounted); a check of each against the task that says which requirement it fails (the area, by the reach test of 32-05 over a grid of the work; the payload; the tilt; the accuracy; the cycle, by the cycle time of 31-07); and a choice of the fastest that passes every one, or none
